title: Sheet Pan Shrimp Fajitas
description: Shrimp, bell peppers, and jalapeños are tossed with olive oil and fajita seasoning in this quick and easy recipe for sheet pan shrimp fajitas.
ingredients: 1.5 pounds raw shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 red bell pepper, sliced into strips
1 yellow bell pepper, sliced into strips

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).
Mix fajita seasoning and olive oil together in a large bowl. Add shrimp; toss to coat.
Lay out seasoned shrimp in a single layer on a baking sheet. Add bell peppers, red onion, and jalapeño; mix with shrimp and spread out evenly.
Roast in the preheated oven until shrimp are opaque, 8 to 10 minutes. Transfer shrimp to a serving plate.
Broil pepper mixture until lightly blackened, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to the serving plate with shrimp.

video.description: One pan shrimp fajitas are a great way to go for those weeknight dinners. Season the shrimp and lay out on a sheet pan along with sliced bell peppers, onion, and jalapeño pepper. Roast until shrimp is opaque, and you have most of dinner ready! Serve with avocado, tortillas, and any other condiments or side dish that you please.
